page.layout: Two engraved coin illustrations side by side at the top; below them one full-width column of running text, two paragraphs. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: CONSTANS, qui & Constantinus, Heraclij Constantini supradicti ex Gregoria, filia Nicetæ Patricij, filius, imperio potitur adnitente Senatu, uti dictū à me est, qui Martinæ scelus execrabatur. Hic dicitur etiam Constantinus tertius, qui valde dilectus ab auo Heraclio, Phocæ succeßsore, magnísque honoribus functus, auitæ tandem impietatis hæres, Martinum Ro. Pontificem sibi aduersantem comprehendi iubet, in exilióque mori cogit. A Saracenis victus aufugit. Biennij ab eisdem induciis impetratis, Italiam petit, ut eam à Longobardis liberet: à quibus etiam victus, in suos conuertit iram, laminas argenteas, quibus Pantheon tegebatur, & alia quædam pretiosa, reliquias hostilium prædarum atque incendiorum aufert: plúsque ornamentorum intra quintū diem urbi detrahit, quàm barbari per tot annos: quicquid Romæ antiqui operis, signorúmue fuit, in Siciliam secum asportat: ubi cum sextū annum agit, & auarè ac crudeliter tributū exigit, in balneis, à ministris, autore Mazefe, interficitur, anno imperij 27. coepit anno mundi 4605. à Christo nato, 643. Pom. Læt. Diaco. lib. 8. Egna. lib. 2.

CONSTANTINVS, natu maximus Constantis prædicti, post patrem imperat. Hic in Siciliam venit, ultúsque Mizizium, siue Mazefen, tyrannum, & cædis paternæ conscios, bellum in Saracenos annos septem terra marique feliciter gessit: vnico congressu 30000. cæcidit: tributarios fecit. Ignis sub aqua ardet, Callinici inventum: quo valde terrentur hostes Arabes. Bulgari trans Danubium derepête bellum ostentant: inhonesta pace, Mysia ad inhabitándum datur, cum annuo tributo. imperat annis 17. Pogonatus dictus, id est barbatus, quòd barbatus è Sicilia rediisset. Egn. lib. 2. Dia. lib. 8. hic è palatio præcipitatus interiit.

page.notes: Two coin engravings above the text, not transcribed as text. Left coin legend: "D.N. CONSTANS P.F. AVG", bust right. Right coin legend: "IMP. CONSTANTINVS P.F. AVG", bust right, laureate. Doubtful readings: "vnico congressu 30000." is printed with spaced digits, copied as shown. "Mazefe" and "Mazefen" are read from the scan and may be slightly off. "derepête" is read with a circumflex over the e. "marique" is read with a tilde over the q, copied as "marique". Printing errors left as printed: "Pom. Læt. Diaco." and "Egna." are abbreviated citations as printed.
